description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for searching provider filters in the OpenID authentication plugin of the OrangeHRM project. It includes properties for filtering by name, status, and ID, along with their respective getter and setter methods, and defines allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: ProviderSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used for filtering provider search queries by name, status, and ID, with allowed sorting fields for the provider entity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the filter's name as a string or null.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the filter's status as a boolean or null.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the filter's ID as an integer or null.
